text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing about a trendy cafe, I decided to 
check it out—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa~... Just like the rumors said, 
it's such a stylish and cosmopolitan 
cafe...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, first time here, but not bad. Looks 
pretty empty too—wait, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright... Carrot, mousse! Fron, zen! 
Mousse, fro, zeeen!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Don't trip over my words, don't let my 
accent slip...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Going ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, City-san?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
'Scuse me, do you have any recommendations 
that aren't too sweet? Ah, small size, 
please.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Also, that banana... bread-like thing. Top 
it with whipped cream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
O-Ooooh...?! That's totally different from 
how they said to order online and in 
books... Yet somehow, somehow!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's so cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...! That's it, as long as you're 
confident, you look cool...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-In that case, I will too...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Scuse me! Give me that carrot one, 
please! With heaps of whipped cream--!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san! Thanks so much for coming with 
me today!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not really, I wanted to come too anyway.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... City-san, were you 
really okay not getting the carrot one?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The calories are kinda... nah, well. 
Wasn't really in the mood, so maybe next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa... So mature and composed.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Not blindly chasing trends and staying 
true to herself... is that what being a 
"City Girl" is all about?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Still, you were totally absorbed in 
it. Was that carrot thing really that 
good?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Get this, inside the whipped 
cream there were tiny bits of carrot, and 
the ice cream too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trading their thoughts on the flavors, the 
two enjoyed a fun after-school hangout.
